ox.tax.bundles.description: Ready made bundles combine more than one product in one offer at one price, so you spend less time comparing and adding to the cart. Every bundle lists its contents and its price before you buy.
ox.tax.bundles.faq_1_a: A bundle is sold as listed on its product page, and one item cannot be swapped for another inside the same bundle. Anyone who wants a different combination can buy each product separately.
ox.tax.bundles.faq_1_q: Can I swap one product in a bundle for another?
ox.tax.bundles.faq_2_a: Yes, every bundle page lists the combined price of the individual products next to the bundle price, so the difference is clear before checkout.
ox.tax.bundles.faq_2_q: Is a bundle cheaper than buying the products separately?
ox.tax.bundles.faq_3_a: Some bundles are built to make starting easier and combine core products, but they still depend on your goal and how you will actually use them.
ox.tax.bundles.faq_3_q: Are bundles suited to a beginner?
ox.tax.bundles.intro: OptimalX bundles combine related products in one offer, instead of choosing each product on its own. They suit you if you already know what you need and want to shorten the comparison. Every bundle lists its contents and its price before you buy.
ox.tax.bundles.name: Bundles
ox.tax.bundles.title: Ready Made Supplement Bundles | OptimalX

ox.tax.digital_library.description: A digital library of guides explaining practical supplement use, delivered instantly after purchase with no shipping or delivery wait.

ox.tax.digital_library.faq_1_q: How do I receive the file after I buy it?
ox.tax.digital_library.faq_2_a: The return policy for digital products is listed on the store's own returns policy page.
ox.tax.digital_library.faq_2_q: Can a digital product be returned once it is opened?
ox.tax.digital_library.faq_3_a: Yes. The guides are written in plain language and explain the basics before the details.
ox.tax.digital_library.faq_3_q: Is the content suited to a beginner?
ox.tax.digital_library.intro: Digital guides and files that explain the basics of supplements in a practical, clear way: creatine, protein and how to read a label. The content is general guidance, and it does not replace a specialist's advice for a specific health condition.
ox.tax.digital_library.name: Digital Library
ox.tax.digital_library.title: Digital Library of Supplement Guides | OptimalX
ox.tax.gift_cards.description: OptimalX digital gift cards: credit you give to anyone you choose, which the recipient spends in the store on the product that suits them. Validity and how to use it are on the card's page.
ox.tax.gift_cards.faq_1_a: The card is usually delivered by email or message after checkout, depending on the method shown on the product page at the time of purchase.
ox.tax.gift_cards.faq_1_q: How does the gift card reach the recipient?
ox.tax.gift_cards.faq_2_a: The credit's validity is listed on the card's own product page before purchase.
ox.tax.gift_cards.faq_3_a: Yes, the card credit is used toward a purchase from the store like any other payment method, within the terms listed on the card's page.
ox.tax.gift_cards.faq_3_q: Can the card be used on any product in the store?
ox.tax.gift_cards.intro: An OptimalX gift card is digital store credit used toward a purchase from the store. It suits you when you want to give a gift and are not sure which product fits, since the recipient chooses for themselves. Validity and how to use the credit are on the card's page.
ox.tax.gift_cards.name: Gift Cards
ox.tax.gift_cards.title: Digital Supplement Gift Cards | OptimalX
